method: slop-forensics comparison on the TP-3765 script-tells corpus (TP-4305): words, bigrams and trigrams said at least 5 times as often in our scripts and the other models' scripts as in the human explainers, in at least 3 of those scripts. Literature-seeded items kept only when they pass here; data-derived items kept only when they show in both families and read as voice, not subject matter.
